status: Partial human reconstruction of RH and unrestricted Dirichlet GRH, accepting the pinned Alpoge-Claude formal proof as correct. Version 0.50 adds 98 independently reviewed numbered claims, bringing the cumulative inventory to 3112. It completes arbitrary-coefficient test-ring descent, normalized theta points and every FrameOK field, uniform character seeds and much of the actual common marked frame, large-parameter Bessel nonvanishing and its universal return, the analytic final propagation step, and the full conditional global denominator export. No additional whole selected obligation is closed: 24 remain, comprising 17 class C and 7 class B, with 17 shared RH/GRH and 7 additional Dirichlet-GRH obligations. Full StepStatement, full simultaneous principal frames, the remaining common arithmetic frame and automorphy producers, actual ConclF families and other listed producers remain explicit. The existing full GLOBAL_LOCAL_GAIN closure is preserved. Claim counts are an inventory, not a completion percentage. No Lean build or kernel replay is claimed.
local_conclusions: TDR1-TDR13 prove the complete original finite-generated-subalgebra descent for actual FrPt over arbitrary coefficient algebras, including nonreduced, non-Noetherian and nonflat targets. The Lie eigenframe bundles and theta-section frame line represent the literal framed point functor; a direct local finite-data argument gives the same conclusion. For reduced targets a finite polynomial presentation followed by the radical quotient gives the exact TRing and FrMap, proving allTest_of_secBaseChange and the literal FromTest return. The supplied Moduli and exact SecBaseChangeSt are retained; section base change is used at the locally Noetherian universal base without imposing Noetherianity or flatness on the target.

NFR1-NFR13 construct the original ThetaData and actual normalized framed points, and prove every FrameOK field. They identify the exact CM embedding and reversed-column period dictionary, prove holomorphic periods on the connected domain, and give an integral symplectic basis with the original modulus-eight adaptation. A direct Fourier recurrence proves the actual complex theta section line is one-dimensional without a new section-twisting or base-change premise. The original Hermitian determinant, unit-minor determinant, lattice fundamental domain, quadratic gauge and theta mean are calculated with all constants. The normConst square root makes the Gaussian mean exactly one. One simultaneous family satisfies the first FramesOK field; the pointwise FromTest conclusion retains TDR SecBaseChangeSt. The other three FramesOK fields, CoverTri, FibTri and full IsUnf remain.

CAF1-CAF11 prove the full original SeedClause with one modulus chosen before every later compatible L and witness prime w. The proof includes the exact local norm/Teichmuller/conductor argument, an actual imaginary quadratic field and discriminant, an order-ell auxiliary character and actual witness prime, and the prescribed fixed field inside the original algebraic closure. An elementary Euclid-cyclotomic argument supplies the required primes congruent to one, so Dirichlet prime progression input is unnecessary here. The Dat modulus is |discr K| times N_(ell-prime); the separate CountV HostData seed uses N_(ell-prime)^2 and retains ell=3. These are actual character seeds on the same supplied marked frame, not the later rank-two and rank-three automorphic seed representations or a complete Gen condition.

MFC1-MFC14 construct the original linked marked frame under the full original Gen and GC.Hypotheses2 inputs. A CRT construction gives a positive nonsquare n with n congruent to -1 modulo 4M and valuation one at a fresh odd prime; the real quadratic field Q(sqrt(Dn)) supplies the original H0 output without a prime progression theorem. The proof constructs Hlay, proves all twelve UFacts, obtains one b0 class-rank bound before every m using inherited TW1, and proves literal link_ex with every GalLink/FLink field. It proves strictness for both original characters and both f4 cone classes and gives actual common L, g1, Phi, C0 and w with Big and 21 of the 28 Ok fields. When O=c.O is the original coefficient DVR, the CAF seed joins this same frame with its modulus chosen first. The seven generic GC outputs phi/gen/cl/ec/b1p/b1/h1 and the full Gen_gd/Gen_host entry implications remain explicit; full GdFrameEx, HostFrameEx and GdEnd are not inferred.

BNV1-BNV23 prove the original IntS exponent b>2rn^2, the complete finite parameter Walk, the cubic-gap comparisons and the full large-parameter StepIBase nonvanishing. An explicit Vandermonde isotropic frame and Cayley matrix match the original character c_a(t)=-2it, including its trace sign and factor. Polynomial exp/log coordinates give the original Haar measure; a global Cayley majorant and Casimir estimates give the tangent Gaussian and its nonzero complex Gaussian integral. The GaussianLimitHaar proof has one eventual bound before all integration variables and retains AE-strong measurability; the Schur averaging factor is exactly 1/dim(Vpi) for any allowed sigma-finite ambient second measure. Absolute convergence, actual Levi/character transport, compact cyclicity and the reconciliation of independently supplied Cayley witnesses give the full universal return to the original endomorphism integral. The remaining StepStatement is explicit in BNV23; BesselNVGap and ConcreteSettingExists follow conditionally, the latter retaining the original Forms0 scope.

BSP1-BSP10 prove the full original GapNeedStatement, PsiDatumStatement, CapValStatement, MultStatement, PerStatement and FinStatement, with their original supplied data. Cyclic lowest-type rigidity and coefficient orthogonality give pointwise finProj on the actual right-regular space. The original ordered Capelli polynomial acts by its exact scalar on the entire generated module. Dominated differentiation gives the actual period derivative, including its literal real-smooth ambient meaning. The final Fubini argument uses the simpler product majorant rho(y)^(-beta)rho(y^-1g)^(-beta) <= rho(g)^(-beta/4)rho(y)^(-beta/2), at the exact source exponents. It returns the actual nonzero Bessel integral from a supplied shifted lowest type and its exact period-injectivity premise. Tensor coefficient maps, complementary-minor eigenspaces/evaluation and shifted quotient existence still supply the original StepStatement.

DNE1-DNE14 prove the complete original ConclF-to-AdmF-to-LinkN implication. The patched local denominator table includes the prime-three equal-share branch, all seventeen AdmT fields, exact coefficient-weight/host-degree conversion and zero cases. A CRT/LTE cyclotomic budget and explicit ordinary, small-order, band, exceptional, generator and small-prime estimates bound every original prime sum. Uniform exponential scale comparisons replace the source numerical Large cutoff while preserving the original eventual quantifiers. The original UniformExportStatement has K=2000(|Ca|+1)^3 fixed before every family, and retains ShaFinOdd and vvTerm summability. The upstream actual common ConclF family is not constructed, so this complete consumer does not close GLOBAL_DENOMINATOR.
